class.name: GameplayServerConfig
class.brief_description: Headless dedicated-server startup and shutdown configuration.
class.description: GameplayServerConfig configures the ENet listener and session timing. [method apply_command_line] recognizes [code]--gameplay-bind[/code], [code]--gameplay-port[/code], [code]--gameplay-max-clients[/code], [code]--gameplay-protocol[/code], [code]--gameplay-grace-msec[/code], and [code]--gameplay-shutdown-msec[/code], with either separate or [code]=[/code] values.

method.name: apply_command_line
method.description: Applies recognized headless arguments and rejects invalid values.
